members.note: Verbatim title from content/sources.json (en-kff-tracking-feb2025). Average guess 26 percent of the federal budget against about 1 percent actual; 11 percent guessed correctly; support flips 58 to 34 once informed. The $43.8B dollar figure is NOT on this page and does not ship.
